settings.title: How to use
settings.content:
Push the cap down and turn to open. Tap 2–3 orbs onto your palm, press to burst them into serum, then pat into clean skin morning and night and follow with moisturiser.

Close the cap tightly after use — the orbs are sealed doses and the cap keeps the rest of the bottle that way.

If your skin reacts easily, patch test on your inner arm for 24 hours first.

settings.question: What is PDRN?
settings.answer: PDRN stands for polydeoxyribonucleotide, a fragment of DNA sourced from salmon. In skincare it is used as a hydrating, conditioning ingredient. Ours sits at 30,000ppm alongside hyaluronic acid.

settings.question: How do I use it?
settings.answer:
Tap 2–3 orbs onto your palm. Press to burst them into serum, then pat into clean skin morning and night, and follow with moisturiser.

If your skin reacts easily, patch test on your inner arm for 24 hours first.

settings.question: Is it vegan?
settings.answer: No. PDRN is salmon-derived, so the serum is not vegan. It is not tested on animals.
